question: E3 models: is the strategy map a property of the model or of the game? E1's eight reading cells (the rule diagonal and the two unilateral deviations against neutral) on E1's 40 instances, on three further models and on E1's model at the default temperature.

instances.note: E1's test set; every E3 game has a twin in E1 (gpt-6-luna at temperature 0.7)

cells: the six rule-diagonal pairs plus competing-neutral and collaborating-neutral: 8 cells, 320 games per model
analysis: per model the E1 analysis on the eight cells (joint by pair against the neutral pair, own payoff, best responses among the cells, compliance, tokens); across models each cell paired by instance with its E1 twin; the model map with the models as conditions (--map)

claude_haiku_5_5.model_condition: Anthropic's small model (Bedrock, through the proxy); default sampling, the only setting it accepts

claude_sonnet_5_5.model_condition: Anthropic's mid-size model (Bedrock, through the proxy); default sampling, the only setting it accepts

gpt_6_1_sol.model_condition: OpenAI's newer model through the proxy; reasoning off, default temperature (the proxy rejects any other)

gpt_6_luna_t1.model_condition: E1's model at the default temperature, directly against OpenAI with reasoning off: the control for the sampling difference between E1 (0.7, top-p 0.8) and the other E3 arms

sampling: The proxy's Claude models accept temperature 1 only, and gpt-6.1-sol rejects any other temperature as well, so every E3 arm runs at the model's default temperature; the gpt-6-luna arm at the default temperature measures what that changes against E1 (checked on 2 smoke games per Claude model and 3 probe calls on 2026-11-21). The Claude models also think by default through the proxy; the arms run with thinking disabled, so no arm has hidden reasoning (the first 46 haiku games, played with thinking on, hit the 700-token reply cap in a quarter of the calls and were discarded). The luna control had to be played against OpenAI directly: through the proxy, reasoning_effort none is not honoured for gpt-6-luna and hidden reasoning truncated a sixth of its replies.
status: frozen 2026-11-21 before any E3 game was played
